title: A Bit of Relief: Jody's Playlist

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《Dealbook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最具影响力的人物，包括 J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些坦诚、未经删减的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: My name is Jody Rosen.
sentences.zh: 我叫乔迪·罗森。

sentences.en: I'm a writer for the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: I cover a bunch of different things for the magazine, but one of the things that I write and think a lot about is music.
sentences.zh: 我为杂志报道各种不同的事情，但我经常写作和思考的主题之一就是音乐。

sentences.en: And while so many of us are stuck inside, finding new rhythms for our days, I thought I'd share with you some of the music that I've been thinking about and listening to.
sentences.zh: 当我们在屋里待得很久、为日常生活寻找新的节奏时，我想和大家分享一些我一直在思考和聆听的音乐。

sentences.en: One of the artists I've been listening to quite a bit is the singer Alberta Hunter.
sentences.zh: 我最近经常听的艺术家之一是歌手阿尔伯塔·亨特。

sentences.en: In particular, this song of hers is called My Castle's Rockin'.
sentences.zh: 特别是她的这首歌，名叫《我城堡的摇滚》。

sentences.en: There are certain pieces of music that seem like they're kind of engineered in the lab to raise your spirits.
sentences.zh: 有些音乐听起来就像是在实验室里精心设计出来振奋精神的。

sentences.en: That swing that is just infectious.
sentences.zh: 那种摇摆感极具感染力。

sentences.en: Just brings this instant boost to your spiritual immune system.
sentences.zh: 能瞬间为你的精神免疫系统充电。

sentences.en: Now the thing you need to know about Alberta Hunter is she has this fascinating backstory.
sentences.zh: 关于阿尔伯塔·亨特，你需要知道的是，她有着一段迷人的背景故事。

sentences.en: Hunter was one of those black Americans who, after the turn of the century, left the south, moved north, in her case to Chicago.
sentences.zh: 亨特是那些在世纪之交离开南方、向北迁移的非裔美国人之一，她搬到了芝加哥。

sentences.en: And in the 1920s and 30s, she was one of the blues women who pioneered this new kind of American popular singing, performing these urbane, sexy, funny songs full of attitude.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20和30年代，她是开创这种全新美国流行唱法的蓝调女歌手之一，演唱这些充满个性、都市感、性感且滑稽的歌曲。

sentences.en: It's really music that laid the groundwork for much of what has come in the centuries since.
sentences.zh: 这确实为后来几个世纪的大部分音乐奠定了基础。

sentences.en: She remained a professional singer into the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 她作为职业歌手一直唱到了20世纪50年代。

sentences.en: But in the early part of that decade, she stopped.
sentences.zh: 但在那个年代初期，她停了下来。

sentences.en: She vanished from American popular music, kind of dropped off the radar of American popular culture, and embarked on a new career as a healthcare worker.
sentences.zh: 她从美国流行乐坛消失了，在某种程度上淡出了美国流行文化的视线，并开始了一份作为医护人员的新职业。

sentences.en: She went to nursing school, got a degree.
sentences.zh: 她去读了护校，拿到了学位。

sentences.en: And for a long time, she worked as a nurse in a New York City hospital, taking care of the sick and the infirm.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，她都在纽约市的一家医院里当护士，照顾病人和体弱者。

sentences.en: And then, I'm going to sing you a pretty song this time.
sentences.zh: 然后，这次我要给你唱一首漂亮的歌。

sentences.en: They don't write songs like this anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在的人们不写这样的歌了。

sentences.en: In the late 1970s, this is a beautiful song.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代末，这是一首动听的歌。

sentences.en: She did something that's quite rare in pop music.
sentences.zh: 她做了一件在流行音乐中相当罕见的事。

sentences.en: She launched this comeback.
sentences.zh: 她复出了。

sentences.en: Most folks nowadays.
sentences.zh: 现在的大多数人。

sentences.en: As a woman in her 80s.
sentences.zh: 作为一位80多岁的女性。

sentences.en: Say old-fashioned ways.
sentences.zh: 说起老派的方式。

sentences.en: Should give place to things that are new.
sentences.zh: 应该给新事物让位。

sentences.en: She got a gig performing at a nightclub in the village.
sentences.zh: 她在村里的一家夜总会找到了一份演出工作。

sentences.en: Somehow I hold to things that are old.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，我还是执着于旧的事物。

sentences.en: Perhaps it's an old-fashioned love.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一份老式的爱。

sentences.en: She also got a record contract, recorded a few albums for
sentences.zh: 她还获得了一份唱片合约，为哥伦比亚唱片公司录制了几张专辑。

sentences.en: Columbia Records.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚唱片公司。

sentences.en: I've got that old-fashioned love.
sentences.zh: 我得到了那种老式的爱。

sentences.en: It's one of the great second-act stories in music.
sentences.zh: 这是音乐史上最伟大的第二春故事之一。

sentences.en: Shakes my ashes, greases my griddle.
sentences.zh: 摇动我的灰烬，润滑我的煎锅。

sentences.en: She was still singing these same my man.
sentences.zh: 她依然在唱着那些关于“我的男人”的歌曲。

sentences.en: Rollicking.
sentences.zh: 喧闹的。

sentences.en: You know, often quite body-dirty blues songs that she'd performed decades earlier.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，通常是几十年前她唱过的那种非常粗俗、色情的蓝调歌曲。

sentences.en: But she's bringing a whole lifetime of wisdom and experience to them.
sentences.zh: 但她为这些歌曲注入了一生积累的智慧和阅历。

sentences.en: Come on up some night, my castle rockin'.
sentences.zh: 某晚来看看吧，我的城堡在摇滚。

sentences.en: So, the song that I've been listening to a lot is one that Hunter first wrote and recorded around 1940.
sentences.zh: 所以，我经常听的那首歌是亨特在1940年前后首次创作并录制的。

sentences.en: But the version that I've been listening to was recorded in 1978, right at the beginning of her comeback.
sentences.zh: 但我听的版本录制于1978年，正值她复出的初期。

sentences.en: Stuff is there and a chick's valley romp with glee
sentences.zh: 东西就在那儿，姑娘的峡谷狂欢得兴高采烈

sentences.en: It's a song about a party.
sentences.zh: 这是一首关于派对的歌。

sentences.en: In fact, it's a party invitation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一张派对请柬。

sentences.en: Come on up, bring your friends, and we'll start that ball rolling And she goes on to describe what sounds kind of like an illicit, prohibition-era house party.
sentences.zh: 上来吧，带上你的朋友，我们要让派对热闹起来，她接着描述了一场听起来有点像禁酒令时期的非法家庭派对。

sentences.en: Don't worry about a thing, cause I'm paying the cops for protection
sentences.zh: 不用担心任何事，因为我在付钱给警察求保护

sentences.en: Now, there may be an autobiographical component here.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里可能包含一些自传性质的成分。

sentences.en: Alberta Hunter was a lesbian, and the kind of black, bohemian, gay social scene that she was a part of in Chicago and New York
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯塔·亨特是一位女同性恋，她在世纪中叶作为年轻女性在芝加哥和纽约所融入的那种黑人、波希米亚风格的同性恋社交圈

sentences.en: as a young woman in the mid-century was, by definition, illicit.
sentences.zh: 按定义来说是非法的。

sentences.en: So, I'm sure she must have attended or maybe even hosted secret house parties in her time.
sentences.zh: 所以，我确信她当时一定参加过甚至举办过秘密家庭派对。

sentences.en: Of course, you can't host a real house party right now.
sentences.zh: 当然，你现在不能办真正的家庭派对。

sentences.en: It's not a time to invite all your friends over like Alberta Hunter.
sentences.zh: 现在可不是像阿尔伯塔·亨特那样邀请所有朋友过来的时候。

sentences.en: But when I put on Alberta Hunter, I feel like this is an aspirational anthem for a world in lockdown.
sentences.zh: 但当我播放阿尔伯塔·亨特时，我觉得这是写给封锁中的世界的一首渴望的赞歌。

sentences.en: I say now, tip on in some night, my castle's rockin'.
sentences.zh: 我说，某晚进来吧，我的城堡在摇滚。

sentences.en: But there's something else, there's something, I think, bracing, or maybe it's reassuring in hearing the voice of this elderly person that's so full of spirit and is so sly,
sentences.zh: 但还有别的东西，我认为，听到这位老年人的声音如此充满活力、如此狡黠，给人一种振奋，或者也许是安慰，

sentences.en: you know, at this super frightening time, to hear that voice of longevity, I guess,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这个超级可怕的时期，听到这种长寿的声音，我想，

sentences.en: a voice that really embodies this idea of a long life that's fully lived, that's festively lived.
sentences.zh: 一种真正体现了过上充实、尽情狂欢的长寿人生的声音。

sentences.en: That's just something that I need to hear right now.
sentences.zh: 这正是我现在需要听到的。

sentences.en: And the next song I want to play,
sentences.zh: 我接下来想放的歌是，

sentences.en: It's a song called I'll Get By by this performer named Nick Lucas.
sentences.zh: 是一首由名叫尼克·卢卡斯的表演者演唱的名为《我能度过》的歌。

sentences.en: This song is recorded in 1928, almost exactly a year before the stock market crash.
sentences.zh: 这首歌录制于1928年，几乎正好在股市崩盘前的一年。

sentences.en: All the wealth and power I may never find
sentences.zh: 我可能永远找不到所有的财富和权力

sentences.en: And it has lyrics that anticipate, almost eerily anticipate, the sentiments that filled those Depression-era songs.
sentences.zh: 它的歌词几乎诡异地预示了那些大萧条时期歌曲中的情绪。

sentences.en: There are lines in the song that go
sentences.zh: 歌里有这样几句

sentences.en: There may be rain and darkness too, I'll not complain, I'll laugh it through.
sentences.zh: 也许会有雨和黑暗，我不会抱怨，我会笑着度过。

sentences.en: It's that message of resiliency, the knowledge that hard times are out there on the horizon,
sentences.zh: 正是那种韧性的信息，懂得艰难险阻就在地平线上，

sentences.en: kind of determination to meet the hard times and to persevere.
sentences.zh: 一种迎接艰难险阻并坚持下去的决心。

sentences.en: That's a theme that you hear in so many songs of the Depression.
sentences.zh: 这是你在许多大萧条时期的歌曲中都能听到的话题。

sentences.en: It's one that's really speaking to me these days as we confront a world in turmoil, an economy that's in a tailspin, the prospect of incredibly difficult days ahead.
sentences.zh: 当我们面对一个陷入动荡的世界、一个陷入低谷的经济体以及前方令人难以置信的艰难日子的前景时，这首歌真的说到了我的心坎里。

sentences.en: The next artist I've been listening to a lot is pretty different from Nick Lucas.
sentences.zh: 我最近常听的下一位艺术家和尼克·卢卡斯大不相同。

sentences.en: What can I say about Missy Elliott?
sentences.zh: 我能对梅西·埃利奥特说些什么呢？

sentences.en: Of course, Missy is a great rapper and entertainer and dancer.
sentences.zh: 当然，梅西是一位伟大的说唱歌手、艺人和舞者。

sentences.en: But she's more than that.
sentences.zh: 但她不仅于此。

sentences.en: She's like, like a piece of Americana up there with, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 她就像，就像美国文化的一部分，和，我不知道，

sentences.en: George Washington, Mark Twain, Bugs Bunny, Louis Armstrong, whatever you got.
sentences.zh: 乔治·华盛顿、马克·吐温、兔八哥、路易斯·阿姆斯特朗，随便什么你喜欢的平起平坐。

sentences.en: You know, she represents to me the very best of what American culture has given to the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我看来，她代表了美国文化给予世界的最好东西。

sentences.en: And a Missy Elliott song that I've been listening to a whole lot is Lick Shots from 2001.
sentences.zh: 我一直在单曲循环的一首梅西·埃利奥特的歌是2001年的《Lick Shots》。

sentences.en: It's a record where you can really hear what a great, pure vocal stylist Elliott is.
sentences.zh: 在这张唱片里，你真的能听到埃利奥特是一位多么伟大、纯粹的人声风格大师。

sentences.en: You don't want to speak my name.
sentences.zh: 你不想说出我的名字。

sentences.en: Mess around, get that ass blown away.
sentences.zh: 瞎胡闹，小心屁股被打穿。

sentences.en: Food gone away.
sentences.zh: 食物消失了。

sentences.en: I ain't never let you tell anyway.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会让你告诉任何人的。

sentences.en: In the way she syncopates her vocals.
sentences.zh: 从她人声的切分节奏中。

sentences.en: In the different effects she achieves with her voice.
sentences.zh: 从她用声音达到的不同效果中。

sentences.en: Grunts, shrieking.
sentences.zh: 咕哝声，尖叫声。

sentences.en: I'm a crazy hoe.
sentences.zh: 我是一个疯狂的荡妇。

sentences.en: She moans.
sentences.zh: 她呻吟着。

sentences.en: It's a really transfixing performance, and it's what I love about Missy Elliott.
sentences.zh: 这是一场真正令人着迷的表演，这也是我爱梅西·埃利奥特的原因。

sentences.en: And this song, like most of Missy Elliott's great records, was produced by Timbalt,
sentences.zh: 这首歌和梅西·埃利奥特的大多数伟大唱片一样，是由蒂巴尔特制作的，

sentences.en: who's one of the supreme record producers of all time.
sentences.zh: 他是史上最顶尖的唱片制作人之一。

sentences.en: He's got a great ear for hooks.
sentences.zh: 他对抓耳的旋律有着敏锐的触觉。

sentences.en: In Lick Shots, putting together a drum beat and maybe a keyboard line, or a little sample, a snatch of guitar.
sentences.zh: 在《Lick Shots》中，将鼓点和也许是键盘旋律，或者一个小采样、一小段吉他组合在一起。

sentences.en: Lots of producers will just kind of stop there.
sentences.zh: 许多制作人到此就会停下来。

sentences.en: You know, they'll create the hook and kind of loop it for a few minutes and that's enough.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会创造出抓耳的旋律并循环播放几分钟，这就够了。

sentences.en: But every few bars in Lick Shots, you can hear something surprising happening.
sentences.zh: 但在《Lick Shots》中，每隔几小节，你就能听到一些令人惊奇的事情发生。

sentences.en: A new percussive element for a few measures.
sentences.zh: 持续几小节的新打击乐元素。

sentences.en: A little harmony vocal that kind of shoots up and recedes super quick.
sentences.zh: 一段一闪而过又迅速消逝的和声人声。

sentences.en: He'll drop the beat out two minutes and 20 seconds into Lick Shots.
sentences.zh: 他在《Lick Shots》进行到两分二十秒时会把节拍抽掉。

sentences.en: He introduces this kind of spooky little counter melody on a synthesizer.
sentences.zh: 他在合成器上引入了一种诡异的小对位旋律。

sentences.en: And that takes the song to another new place.
sentences.zh: 这把这首歌带到了另一个全新的境界。

sentences.en: Of course you can hear all these great details if you're listening in headphones.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你用耳机听，你能听到所有这些精彩的细节。

sentences.en: But the way I've been playing this music in my house is by turning it up loud.
sentences.zh: 但我家里播放这音乐的方式是把它开得很大声。

sentences.en: And throwing a little dance party.
sentences.zh: 然后开一个小型的化装舞会。

sentences.en: My wife and kids and I have been taking the opportunity to get silly, move around the apartment, sweat a little, and relieve some of that stress and anxiety that we're all feeling.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子及孩子们一直在利用这个机会释放天性、在公寓里走动、微微出汗，并缓解我们所有人都能感受到的压力和焦虑。

sentences.en: Of course the dance party can't last all night.
sentences.zh: 当然，舞会不能通宵达旦。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, when it's time to wind things down, go to bed, and kind of sit there with my own thoughts,
sentences.zh: 到了一天结束时，当是时候让一切平静下来、上床睡觉，独自面对自己的思绪时，

sentences.en: I've been reaching for one of my favorite records of all time.
sentences.zh: 我一直会找我最喜欢的唱片之一来听。

sentences.en: Al Green's I'm Still In Love With You, a record from 1972.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·格林的《I'm Still In Love With You》，一张1972年的唱片。

sentences.en: And a song I've been listening to and really needing to hear a lot these past several days,
sentences.zh: 而这首歌我一直在听，在过去的几天里真的非常需要听到，

sentences.en: is this song called Simply Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 就是这首名为《Simply Beautiful》的歌。

sentences.en: It's a kind of an unusual song.
sentences.zh: 这是一首有点不寻常的歌。

sentences.en: Al Green plays guitar on the song, which is not something he did very often.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·格林在这首歌中弹奏了吉他，这可不是他经常做的事。

sentences.en: It's very, very quiet and subdued.
sentences.zh: 它非常非常安静和低沉。

sentences.en: And his voice is close mic, so it's got this super intimate sound.
sentences.zh: 他的声音是用近距离麦克风收音的，因此有一种超级亲密的声音质感。

sentences.en: It's almost like he's whispering in your ear.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像他在你耳边低语一样。

sentences.en: Which makes sense, because let's not be coy about it.
sentences.zh: 这很合情合理，因为我们不必拐弯抹角。

sentences.en: It's what they used to call baby-making music.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们过去常说的造人音乐。

sentences.en: And I'm certain that this record has been, shall we say, put to use over the decades, many, many times.
sentences.zh: 我确信这张唱片在过去的几十年里，可以说是被派上了用场，很多很多次。

sentences.en: Sometimes, yes, it's a song about love and sex, but it's also about beauty itself.
sentences.zh: 有时，是的，这是一首关于爱和性的歌，但它也是关于美本身的。

sentences.en: You know, the beauty of the song can really bowl you over.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这首歌的美真的能震撼到你。

sentences.en: There's an especially amazing moment that comes around three minutes into the song,
sentences.zh: 有一个特别惊艳的时刻出现在歌曲进行到大约三分钟的时候，

sentences.en: when the music is kind of dropped into a vamp.
sentences.zh: 当时音乐变成了一种即兴反复乐段。

sentences.en: And then he unleashes this falsetto moan before a steadier beat kicks in for the first time in the song.
sentences.zh: 接着他释放出这种假声呻吟，随后歌曲中迎来了首次更加稳定的节拍。

sentences.en: It's got to be one of the best moments I've ever heard on any record.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我在任何唱片里听过的最美妙的时刻之一。

sentences.en: For me, this song is therapeutic.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这首歌具有治疗作用。

sentences.en: You know, well before I'd ever heard of the coronavirus,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，早在听说冠状病毒之前，

sentences.en: I've used this song to chill out, to commune with the spirit of Al Green, and I guess to like, not to be too grandiose about it,
sentences.zh: 我就用这首歌来放松、与阿尔·格林的精神对话，我想，不要表现得太宏大，

sentences.en: but to connect to the larger beauty that exists in the universe.
sentences.zh: 而是要与宇宙中存在的更广阔的美相连。

sentences.en: That's what I hear in this performance.
sentences.zh: 这就是我在这次表演中所听到的。

sentences.en: And over the last couple weeks, as I, like everyone else, has been kind of consumed with this anxiety and fear and sense of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，我和其他人一样，一直被这种焦虑、恐惧和不确定感所吞噬。

sentences.en: I've been reaching for this song, putting it in my earbuds at night,
sentences.zh: 我一直在寻找这首歌，在夜晚把它塞进耳机里，

sentences.en: and allowing it to kind of wash over me as I fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 让它在我入睡时将我整个人包裹洗涤。

sentences.en: So from my Brooklyn apartment to wherever you're listening out there, take comfort where you can, and take care.
sentences.zh: 所以，从我在布鲁克林的公寓到外面的无论你在哪里收听，能在哪里找到慰藉就去找吧，保重。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》中，我们要为假期招待客人家做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要全黑才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡觉时会失去意识那种昏迷。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们需要什么样的光照？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 它们有什么过敏源或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 它们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 它们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App上或通过你喜欢的收听平台收听The Wirecutter Show。
